lines.en: Straw boots tread the field ridge.
It steps around the newly sprouted shoots.

lines.zh: 手臂上的麦穗晃来晃去
lines.en: Wheat ears swing on its arms.

lines.zh: 它沿田垄慢慢走到尽头
lines.en: It walks the row slowly to its end.
It counts the seedlings in the field.
It props up a fallen stalk.
Its straw hat is crooked and it does not fix it.
It stands at the field corner, blocking the wind.
A few grains fall between its straw seams.
Turn head, where is the player?
Look around, where is the player?
It looks at you, then down at the ground.
It pays attention to the soles of your boots.
Its woven eyes turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我的麦秆手臂被扯掉一束。
lines.en: A sheaf of my wheat-straw arm is torn away.
Half my straw leg came loose.

lines.zh: 干草散了，麦子掉了一地。
lines.en: My hay is coming apart; wheat's all over the ground.

lines.zh: 我倒进泥里，压坏了两行苗。
lines.en: I fall in the mud and crush two rows of sprouts.

lines.zh: 稻草吸了水，沉得迈不动腿。
lines.en: The straw soaks up water and grows too heavy to move.

lines.zh: 你扔给它一根小麦，它高兴地笑了。
lines.en: You throw a wheat to it, it smiles happily.

lines.zh: 它用温和的声音说：我会保护你。
lines.en: It says gently: I’ll protect you.

lines.zh: 它看着你，眼中充满感激。
lines.en: It looks at you, its eyes full of gratitude.

lines.zh: 它张开大嘴，露出满口牙齿。
lines.en: It opens its big mouth, showing its teeth.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着友好的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes shine with friendly light.

lines.zh: 你给了它一些小麦，它点头感谢。
lines.en: You give it some wheat, it nods in thanks.

lines.zh: 它围着你转了几圈，表示认可。
lines.en: It circles you a few times, showing approval.

lines.zh: 它用粗糙的手臂抱着你。
lines.en: It hugs you with its rough arms.

lines.zh: 你给了它一块面包，它笑了。
lines.en: You give it a bread, it smiles.
It looks at you, its eyes gentle.

lines.zh: 你踢到了它，它发出一声叹息。
它的身体发出轻微的晃动。
它被你撞到了，显得有些不满。
lines.en: It’s knocked off balance, a bit unhappy.

lines.zh: 它试图稳定自己的身体。
它被撞倒了，发出轻微的摩擦声。
lines.en: It falls, making a soft scraping sound.

lines.zh: 它被你撞倒，显得有些烦躁。
它被你撞了一下，抱怨道：小心点。
lines.en: It complains: Watch where you’re going.

lines.zh: 它试图调整自己的位置。
它找到一个伙伴，彼此互相注视。
lines.en: It finds a partner, staring at each other.

lines.zh: 它靠近另一个干草傀儡，表示友好。
lines.en: It approaches another hay golem, showing friendliness.

lines.zh: 它试图靠近另一个生物。
lines.en: It tries to approach another creature.

lines.zh: 它伸出手臂，邀请另一只。
lines.en: It extends its arms, inviting another.

lines.zh: 它和另一个傀儡互相点头致意。
lines.en: It nods to another golem in greeting.

lines.zh: 它和另一个生物互相打量。
它和另一只干草傀儡彼此交流。
lines.en: It communicates with another hay golem.

lines.zh: 它试图和另一只生物建立联系。
lines.en: It tries to establish a connection with another creature.

lines.zh: 它和另一只生物相互点头。
它和另一只生物互相点头致意。
lines.en: It greets another creature with nods.

lines.zh: 有脚步踩进我的田里了。
它盯上了踩苗的那只脚
lines.en: It fixates on the foot that stepped on a shoot.
A line of prints appears in the field.
It turns sideways and blocks the field gate.
It decides this plot must be held.
I plant myself across the ridge and will not shift.
It steps in front of the shoots.
It herds you out of the field.
It plants itself and refuses to budge.
Wield the blade to protect crops!

lines.zh: 保护这片土地，绝不放手！
lines.en: Protect this land, never let go!
A straw fist swings and grains fly.
It shoves you off the ridge.
It blocks your foot with its body.
A straw arm sweeps, raising dust.

lines.zh: 在村庄里诞生，保护庄稼！
lines.en: Born in the village, protect crops!

lines.zh: 诞生于和平之地，保护庄稼！
守护这片土地，是我们的使命！
lines.en: Guard this land, it's our mission!
Protect the village, start with me!

lines.zh: 守护庄稼，是我们存在的意义！

lines.en: Villagers stacked wheat into its shape.
It stands up at the head of the field.
In the smell of wheat, it opens its eyes.
The village clocks off and it starts its watch.

lines.zh: 我从田埂上滚下去，草散开。
lines.en: I roll off the field ridge, straw scattering.
My hay is soaked and heavy.

lines.zh: 干草散了一地，麦子还能补。
lines.en: My hay is scattered, but wheat can patch me.

lines.zh: 田里没有麦子，我的草发黄。
lines.en: No wheat in the field, and my straw yellows.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，干草烧起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and the dry hay catches fire.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，麦穗往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and my wheat heads fall away.
